# `company.vendor_credit_profiles`

Immutable one-to-one vendor-credit revision headers with captured vendor, payable and reference facts.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with transaction_id + revision_id | — | transaction_revisions.id | Immutable revision owning this one-to-one vendor-credit header. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transaction_id + revision_id | — | transaction_revisions.transaction_id, transactions.id | Stable vendor-credit document owning this revision. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this vendor-credit history was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this vendor-credit history. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this vendor-credit history. |
| `type` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | transactions.type | Credit document type; vendor_credit is the only implemented one. |
| `vendor_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_vendor_credit_profiles_reference | vendors.id | Vendor that owes this credit back. |
| `ap_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Accounts payable account debited for the credited total. |
| `supplier_reference` | VARCHAR(128) | yes | — | — | — | — | The supplier's own credit-note number, as entered; null when blank. |
| `supplier_reference_key` | VARCHAR(256) | yes | — | — | ix_vendor_credit_profiles_reference | — | NFC-normalized, trimmed and case-folded reference used to detect a repeat; null when blank. |
| `expense_total_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Home-currency sum of the credited expense lines. |
| `profile_snapshot` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Versioned typed JSON object of resolved header facts and input origins. |
